201.description: The link token, shown only here

put.description: Owner only. Replaces the teachers an assistant works for.

get.description: Every staff role. The subjects of the active workspace in list order, archived ones included.

patch.description: Owner only. Rename, archive or restore.

patch.description: Owner only. Rename, archive or restore.

get.description: Owner: all groups. Teacher: own groups. Assistant: assigned teachers.

post.description: Owner or teacher. A teacher always creates their own group. TEACHER_BOOKED (weekday, startTime, endTime) when the teacher has another active group at an overlapping time; resend with force: true to save anyway.

patch.description: Owner, or the teacher of the group. Only the owner reassigns the teacher. New slots, a new teacher or a restore are checked against the other active groups of the teacher (TEACHER_BOOKED; force: true saves anyway).

get.description: Same visibility as groups. Newest first.

post.description: Owner, the group teacher, or an assigned assistant.

patch.description: A new max score may not be below a recorded score.

put.description: Replaces every result of the exam with the grid sent.

post.description: Queues one result message per guardian of the graded students (siblings merged). Repeats queue nothing new.

get.description: Sessions between two local dates (inclusive), same visibility as groups.

patch.description: Owner, or the teacher of the group. Only a scheduled session moves; TEACHER_BOOKED (date, startTime, endTime) when the teacher has another session at the new time; resend with force: true to save anyway.

post.description: Owner, or the teacher of the group. Only a scheduled session is cancelled.
Owner, the group teacher, or an assigned assistant. Opening an open session again returns the same key. Opens from 30 minutes before the start (SESSION_TOO_EARLY with details.opensAt).

get.description: Numbers for the Today dashboard, for the groups the caller can see.

The dashboard: attendance per visible group per week and exam averages over the last `weeks` weeks (8, 13 or 26), and money in per month for the last 6 months (owner and assistant; null for a teacher).
Owner and assistant: every student whose balance in the groups the caller can see is above zero, biggest first.
Owner and assistant: payments minus their reversals, today and this month, by method, for the groups the caller can see (an assistant: their teachers' groups).
End-of-day cash summary in the workspace timezone: payments minus their reversals, by method, per staff member who recorded the payment. Assistant and teacher: their own; owner: every staff member.
Students enrolled in the session group, for manual marking.

put.description: Manual mark by staff; replaces any scan. Open or closed sessions only.

post.description: Same staff as open. Every active enrolled student without a record is marked absent (auto_close).

200.description: Final attendance and the guardian messages queued

get.description: Server-sent events: every record so far, then each new or changed record as `data: AttendanceRecord`. Read with fetch (it needs the Authorization header), not the generated client.
Entries of the groups the caller can see, newest first, and their sum.

post.description: Needs an Idempotency-Key header: a retry with the same key returns the first entry.
Owner, or whoever recorded the entry. Needs an Idempotency-Key header. The entry stays; a new one cancels it.

get.description: Development and demos only (DEV_FAKE_PHONE=1): the last 100 parent messages sent in the workspace, newest first.

post.description: Student scan. A repeat for the same session returns the first record (the session and student are the idempotency key). At most 10 scans a minute per student phone and 300 per session (RATE_LIMITED).

get.description: Every staff role. Search by normalized name or phone prefix; first 50.
